- SOC 2 questionnaire: Redwood to deliver completed questionnaire v1 — 2026-12-04 — Owner: Hannah (Redwood)

- Review & follow-ups: Nebula review pass / requests — 2026-12-14 to 2026-12-18 — Owner: Tara / Phil
- Final packaging & sign-off: Delivery of final SOC 2 package / artifact list — 2026-12-20 — Owner: Redwood (Maya to validate completeness)

Target commercial close reflected in the original sales plan: 2027-01-14 (dependent on SOC 2 package acceptance).

Dependencies / open items:
- Vendor pen test report: Redwood will confirm availability (may be a summary).
- Data retention policy and backup details: Redwood to include policy doc and retention schedule.
- Contract redlines (procurement): Alex (cc) indicated procurement review; please surface any specific contract timing constraints.

Next steps / asks:
1) Tara — confirm Nebula owners for the security review kickoff and whether 11/30 works.
2) Phil — confirm procurement timeline / whether a PO or SOW is required before evidence review.
3) Connor / Maya (internal) — please use the draft dates above and confirm you can meet the questionnaire and evidence deadlines.

Attachments: meeting recording link (Drive), placeholder SOC 2 questionnaire (we will circulate v1 by 12/04).
